purpose: Owner-authorized PRIVATE, VERSIONED Frappe v16 vendor divergence that moves the framework Pillow pin to 13.0.0. The divergence commit is NOT published to any public frappe repository and is therefore NOT fetchable by remote SHA. This record binds the transport patch, the raw commit object and the exact resulting commit/tree so CI can reconstruct and prove the effective vendor identity locally, without any network fetch of an unpublished SHA.
upstream_support_status: NOT an upstream-supported release. No upstream Frappe v16 release inspected on 2026-10-21 declares Pillow~=13.0.0.
transport: The reviewed one-line patch is applied to the pinned upstream checkout and the EXACT reviewed private commit is reconstructed locally from the recorded raw commit object (git hash-object -t commit -w). The resulting HEAD, HEAD tree, parent, index tree and tracked working tree are all asserted. No remote fetch and no vendor upload: the effective commit is not published anywhere.
fetch_policy: CI MUST NOT fetch, clone or otherwise request effective_commit from any remote. It is reconstructed from commit_object_file, whose exact bytes determine its SHA-1.
tree_note: effective_commit_tree is both the staged tree after applying the patch and the committed tree; the applier asserts equality of index, commit tree and HEAD tree.
